title: Playing with Burbank and Moran uptown and at the Dandy Inn
summary: Jiles recalls the Burbank band with Moran, Talbidge and Lester Lewis, the nights at Messmer's near the Dandy Inn, and an uptown spot they cannot name.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene
